summary: 16-bit twin of the CRT character-output helper sub_58CF35 (FputcCharacterWrite): writes one 16-bit value a1 through the stream object a2, switching read-mode streams to write mode, lazily allocating a stream buffer (skipping the sentinel streams unk_5E6768 / unk_5E6788 when sub_596007 reports them), advancing the write cursor by two, flushing the existing buffer via sub_58E22B when full, and falling back to a direct two-byte write for unbuffered streams. Returns a1 on success and 0xFFFF with error bit 0x20 set on failure.

local_names.v7: bytes free in the buffer before the write

operations.description: v2 = a2; v3 = a2[3] (flag word); v4 = a2[4] (handle/index); v11 = v4.
If write-capable bits 0x82 of the flag word are clear or the EOF bit 0x40 is set, jump to the error path.
If the read-mode flag (bit 0) of a2[3] is set, handle the read-to-write transition.
If the own-buffer flag (bit 0x10) is set, clear read mode with mask 0xFE, reset the write cursor *v2 = v2[2], and rebuild flags; otherwise fall through to the error path.
Error path: set bit 0x20 in a2[3], store it, and return 0xFFFF.
Rebuild flags: v5 = a2[3]; a2[1] = 0; v5 = (v5 & 0xED) | 2; a2[3] = v5 — clears bits 0x10/0x2, sets bit 0x1, marking write mode.
If bits 0x10C of the flags are clear, the buffer allocator has not been initialized yet.
Skip allocator init when the stream is one of the sentinels unk_5E6768 / unk_5E6788 and sub_596007(v4) returns non-zero.
MemoryAllocatorInit(v2) lazily initializes the stream buffer allocator.
Branch on the buffered flag bit 0x108 of a2[3]: buffered write path vs direct two-byte write path.
Buffer-space accounting: v6 = v2[2] (buffer base); v7 = *v2 - v6 (bytes free); advance *v2 = v6 + 2; set a2[1] = v2[6] - 2.
Buffer full (v7 <= 0): select the per-handle descriptor — unk_5E7898 when v4 is -1, else dword_8D4920[v4 >> 5] + 36 * (v4 & 0x1F).
If the descriptor's flag byte at offset 4 has bit 0x20 set, notify/reposition the handle.
sub_58C724(v4, 0, 2) notifies the per-handle descriptor when its text-mode bit 0x20 is set.
Else flush the previously buffered bytes via sub_58E22B(v4, v6, v7).
Store the output value: *(WORD*)v2[2] = a1 into the stream buffer slot; v9 = a1.
Unbuffered path: write the single 16-bit value a1 directly via sub_58E22B(v4, &a1, 2).
On success return v9 (a1); otherwise set error bit 0x20 in a2[3] and return 0xFFFF.
